stories.story_fr: Le Data Center est devenu le moteur principal des revenus et benefices d'AMD, porte par la demande d'infrastructure IA et le ramp des GPU Instinct.
stories.story_en: Data Center is now AMD's primary driver of revenue and earnings growth, fueled by accelerating AI infrastructure demand and the Instinct GPU ramp.
stories.quote: with Data Center now the primary driver of our revenue and earnings growth

stories.story_fr: Meta et AMD prevoient de deployer jusqu'a 6 gigawatts de GPU Instinct, le premier gigawatt etant base sur le futur MI450, signe d'un pipeline de deploiements a grande echelle.
stories.story_en: Meta and AMD plan to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of Instinct GPUs, with the first 1-GW powered by the upcoming MI450, signaling a large-scale deployment pipeline.
stories.quote: Meta and AMD announced plans to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, with the first 1-GW to be powered by a custom AMD Instinct MI450-based GPU.

stories.story_fr: L'engagement client autour des series MI450 et de la plateforme Helios se renforce, les previsions des grands clients depassant les attentes initiales d'AMD.
stories.story_en: Customer engagement around the MI450 Series and Helios is strengthening, with leading customer forecasts exceeding AMD's initial expectations.
stories.quote: Customer engagement around MI450 Series and Helios is strengthening, with leading customer forecasts exceeding our initial expectations and a growing pipeline of large-scale deployments

stories.story_fr: Le controle des exportations US sur le GPU Instinct MI308 a entraine environ 440 M$ de charges sur l'exercice 2025, avec un retour partiel de stock de 360 M$ au T4.
stories.story_en: The U.S. export control on the Instinct MI308 data center GPU drove about $440 million in 2025 charges, with a $360 million inventory release in Q4.
stories.quote: Full year 2025 results included approximately $440 million in net inventory and related charges as a result of the U.S. Government's export control on AMD Instinct MI308 data center GPU products.

stories.story_fr: L'activite Gaming a rebondi avec une croissance de 51% sur l'exercice 2025, portee par des ventes semi-custom ameliorees et une forte demande pour les GPU Radeon.
stories.story_en: The Gaming business rebounded with 51% full-year 2025 growth, driven by improved semi-custom sales and strong demand for Radeon GPUs.
stories.quote: Gaming business revenue was $3.9 billion, up 51% year-over-year, driven by improved semi-custom sales and strong demand for AMD Radeon GPUs.
